scope: Account-bound, user-controlled, forward-only E2EE recovery package

controls.account_binding: SHA256 over versioned Nexus user id and primary MultiversX address
controls.history_claim: future messages only after recovery-device activation

resolved_findings.finding: The first recovery bundle was device-bound but not bound to the originating Nexus account.
resolved_findings.resolution: A pseudonymous account commitment is authenticated in AAD and payload and must match the currently authenticated account before decryption or registration.

resolved_findings.finding: A length-only passphrase rule accepted trivially repetitive offline-guessable values.
resolved_findings.resolution: The client now applies a minimum diversity and estimated entropy floor in addition to length and PBKDF2 cost.

residual_findings.finding: Recovery-device registration and confirmed file persistence are not one atomic operation.
residual_findings.control: The device is visible and revocable in Account Center; the next packet will add pending-to-active activation with expiry and idempotent confirmation.

residual_findings.finding: The local entropy estimate is not a replacement for a generated recovery code or a memory-hard KDF.
residual_findings.control: Weak short/repetitive values are denied; versioned memory-hard KDF selection remains a production cryptography-review gate.

residual_findings.finding: API plus IndexedDB failure injection and concurrent restore are not yet covered end-to-end.
residual_findings.control: Pure cryptographic negative tests and local-key overwrite denial pass; transactional activation and browser fault tests are the next packet.

capacity.reason: Goal reports usageLimited; completed one bounded local packet with one sequential checker
